notes: Source: official Sennheiser "MobileConnect Station Quick Guide" (Publ. 02/21, 583971/A02), which includes a full rear-panel diagram and specification table; cross-referenced against the manufacturer product listing URL https://www.sennheiser.com/en-us/catalog/products/bi-directional-communication/mobileconnect/mobileconnect-station-508895 (confirms product identity/model number 508895). Desktop unit, approx. 212 x 168 x 43 mm, ~970 g, not natively rack-mountable; an optional "GA 3" rack-mount kit (not included) allows mounting two Station units side-by-side in 1U, so rackUnits is omitted per desktop-unit convention. Power: the unit has no AC inlet or DC barrel jack; it is powered exclusively via PoE (IEEE 802.3af Class 3, max 10 W) delivered over the "PoE / Stream" RJ-45 port, so that port is listed as bidirectional data+power rather than a separate power connector. The two Dante ports (Primary/Secondary) and the Ctrl/PoE-Stream RJ-45 ports have no stated Ethernet speed grade in the spec sheet (no 10/100/1000 callout), so "grade" was omitted rather than assumed. XLR analog I/O: 2x XLR-3F inputs (10 kOhm impedance, max input 18 dBu unity / 3 dBu with gain), 2x XLR-3M outputs (max output 4 dBu @ 600 Ohm or 8 dBu @ 200 kOhm), frequency response 40 Hz-20 kHz, S/N 101 dB(A), THD+N -82 dB(A). No HDMI, USB, or video I/O exists on this product; it is a Dante-networked analog audio bridge/station for the Sennheiser MobileConnect assistive-listening system, not a display or switching device.
